notes.title: Viviette Release Date: 18 October 2018
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Our upcoming new game, [b]Viviette[/b], now has an official release date:

[h1]18 October 2018[/h1]

Well, that's next week, on Thursday!

Viviette is an [b]exploration-puzzle[/b] game with touches of [b]classic horror[/b]. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoliers before playing the game, so that you can enjoy the full experience your own way. We think the game is super immersive from start to end.

In adversity, you should persevere. But if you get stuck in the game, just ask for help in the project's [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/]discussions forum[/url]. We won't reply, but surely other players will do. We will only reply to bug reports or technical issues, though we think the game is bug free.

Meanwhile, adding it to your [b]wishlist[/b] will help with visibility before launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/883070/Viviette/

Thanks for reading!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Update v1.0.10 - Difficulty modes!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28943799/1f211ad93a659c5d47d51faa006d35d8840922f6.gif[/img]

Hello again!

With this new update [b]v1.0.10[/b] we have included a new option to select the [b]difficulty level[/b] of the game. By default, the game is set to "Normal", which is a bit more intense than the old default mode. You can also select "Easy" for a more accessible experience, of "Hard" if you're looking for fast action.

We have also tweaked the ball behavior and added a permanent trail, in order to better keep track of the ball in some situations.

For now, and due to some issues, all these recent updates are available for [b]Windows[/b] only.

Thanks for your time!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.notes:

notes.title: Update v1.0.6 - Improvements everywhere!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28943799/058c6a809e88edf9aeb86a7d6a29af1e93e594a1.gif[/img]

Hello!

Since our latest post (v1.0.2), we have added, improved and fixed many things. Here you have all features now included on [b]v1.0.6[/b]:

[b]1.0.6[/b] - [i]12/06/2017[/i]
- Fixed bug where ball got stuck on player.
- Improved color palettes for some stages.
- Added optional gamepad vibration (Windows).
- Continuous player flash if strong attack is charged.

[b]1.0.5[/b] - [i]07/06/2017[/i]
- Improved player attack and ball striking.
- Overly horizontal ball direction is now less probable.
- Enemies now tend to go down.
- Minor fixes and adjustments.

[b]1.0.4[/b] - [i]04/06/2017[/i]
- Fixed "Double Ball" bug.
- Added missing keyboard key names.

[b]1.0.3[/b] - [i]02/06/2017[/i]
- Less life for bricks in 1 player mode (2 hits instead of 3).

Now you can also enable [b]gamepad vibration[/b] on Windows (0 = disabled, 10 = max level):

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28943799/ea40e7a2009fefbfae60c956790924b2b8e2e13f.png[/img]

Gamepad vibration is disabled by default (vibration level = 0).

Thanks for supporting this game!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Update v1.0.2 - Strong attack and Bestiary
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28943799/b1a734eb054a45b3586dfb7b3facec37a6ae862c.gif[/img]

Hello!

We have updated the game twice recently. You can read the full changelog [url=steamcommunity.com/app/643880/discussions/0/1291817208494741742/]here[/url]. This is the important stuff:

[h1]Charge STRONG ATTACK splash screen[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28943799/53d20f2c2a9d6bbcbf757422cfabe25eded9f530.png[/img]

Now, if you're a new player, a splash screen will appear after entering a stage. It explains the importance of [b]charging the strong attack[/b]. You need to master this skill because it's crucial for beating the game, and for having fun. This game is not about dodging projectiles, it's just the contrary. You can [b]destroy ANY projectile[/b] with your normal attack and, in fact, you can [b]REPEL any projectile using the strong attack[/b]. Don't be afraid. Just charge the strong attack and use it at the right time!

[h1]Bestiary info in World Map[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28943799/ba09c36d3b217e0d1c3f54380a860676a88e47d7.png[/img]

Now, only on stages you have cleared, you'll see some interesting info at the top of the screen. You have a count of the coins you got on that stage, and also info about the monsters living in there, and those you have catched.

We hope you like these changes! Keep playing and spread the word, and don't forget to review the game if you like it!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]
